responsibility: Implements the symbol-side representation and class/interface-specific mechanics for D class types. It initializes special runtime classes such as `Object`, `Throwable`, and `TypeInfo_*`, manages base-class and interface relationships, answers base-of queries and offsets, computes interface vtable layout expectations, distinguishes COM/C++ interfaces, and fills interface vtable slots by matching implementing methods in derived classes, making it the class-specific counterpart to the more general aggregate machinery.
